# STYLE-5: A switch over an enum lists every value and has no default

- Without `default:`, a new enum value fails the build (`-Werror=switch`) wherever it is not handled. List values that need nothing as empty cases. A value cast from a parameter or the wire can match no case, so the code after the switch must cope ([ARCH-10](ARCH-10.md)).

Confirmed 2026-11-14. Part of the root playbook, under [Code Style](../claude/CLAUDE.md#code-style). [All rules](../README.md#architectural-rules)
